summary: Settings-by-platform table (first part): ansible_network_os values and which of network_cli, netconf, httpapi and local each platform supports, for Arista EOS, Ciena SAOS6, Cisco ASA/IOS/IOS XR/NX-OS, CloudEngine, Dell OS6/9/10, Ericsson ECCLI and Extreme EXOS.
questions: What ansible_network_os value do I use for Cisco NX-OS?
Does Cisco IOS support NETCONF in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Settings by platform (A to E)
answer_card.answer_md:
| Platform | `ansible_network_os` | network_cli | netconf | httpapi | local |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Arista EOS† | `arista.eos.eos` | ✓ | | ✓ | ✓ |
| Ciena SAOS6 | `ciena.saos6.saos6` | ✓ | | | ✓ |
| Cisco ASA† | `cisco.asa.asa` | ✓ | | | ✓ |
| Cisco IOS† | `cisco.ios.ios` | ✓ | | | ✓ |
| Cisco IOS XR† | `cisco.iosxr.iosxr` | ✓ | | | ✓ |
| Cisco NX-OS† | `cisco.nxos.nxos` | ✓ | | ✓ | ✓ |
| CloudEngine | `community.network.ce` | ✓ | ✓ | | ✓ |
| Dell OS6/OS9/OS10 | `dellemc.os6.os6` etc. | ✓ | | | ✓ |
| Ericsson ECCLI | `community.network.eric_eccli` | ✓ | | | ✓ |
| Extreme EXOS | `community.network.exos` | ✓ | | ✓ | |

† maintained by the Ansible Network Team.
